description: In every model \(M\models Q\), an element \(a\) satisfies \(a<\overline n\), interpreted as \(\exists z\,(z+Sa=\overline n)\), exactly when \(a=\overline m\) for some external natural number \(m<n\). In particular, the strict cut below zero is empty.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.strict_finite_bound.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.Q] (a : M) (n : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M a)
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M n) ↔
    ∃ m < n, a = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M m
